channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Kristi Noem no longer envoy to Shield of the Americas
item.description: Former DHS Secretary Kristi Noem is no longer serving as the Trump administration's envoy to the Shield of the Americas initiative, according to a State Department statement.

item.title: Katie Zacharia leaving press secretary post, sources say
item.description: White House press secretary Katie Zacharia is leaving her role, according to multiple sources and a senior White House official who spoke to ABC News on Friday.

item.title: Federal inquiry into suspicious letters sent to election officials and lawmakers
item.description: Federal investigators are examining suspicious letters containing unidentified substances mailed to state election officials and members of Congress.

item.title: Nat Geo program highlights elephants' daily habits and behaviors
item.description: National Geographic offers a closer look at elephants, noting they can eat up to 18 hours a day and use their trunks to hug.
